gameDescriptionHtml:
After a thousand-year nap sealed deep inside a mountain, the diabolical demon queen Karin is about to be unleashed once more!

Expand your budding labyrinth, and strengthen your squads of fearsome (but cute) demons!

Build amenities to shake intruders down for cash, then send them packing with well-placed traps and bosses!

Sponsored by the demon queen of legend, it’s time to devise a dungeon worthy of your new favorite despot!

Game Features

  • BUILD A FEARSOME LAIR—WITH AMENITIES! – Your dungeon will start with only four rooms, but by spreading the word to nearby people and monsters, you can lure them into your labyrinth to hunt for your hoard. Construct gardens, fishing rooms, statues, and more to catch their attention and extract their cash—but remember to build enough traps and arenas for your generals to expel them before they can break through the dungeon’s heart and get their hands on YOUR loot!
  • RECRUIT ALLIES AND MAXIMIZE THEIR SKILLS! – As you play, new generals and monsters will join your forces. Assign them into squads, then use your hard-earned funds and upgrade items to power them up with ever-increasing stats! Remember to match monsters and generals with strong synergies: only together will they be able to keep your precious hoard safe from those greedy, money-grubbing adventurers!
  • CROSS PLAYTHROUGHS WITH THE COMPASS! – Every time you finish a playthrough, you’ll get a rating and maybe an achievement… but is that really as far as you can go?! Start a New Game and carry over your data—your dungeon will start from scratch, but your units’ power will remain, allowing you to reach new areas and encounter more lucrative dupes to attract to your dungeon and trounce for cash. Eventually, you’ll unlock the Compass, a powerful magical artifact that lets you unlock new room types and power up your forces to even greater heights that’ll stay with you into the next run!
